scenarios.label: Direct downloads
scenarios.detail: Many unrelated one-recipient transfers with moderate client goodput.

scenarios.label: Shared release asset
scenarios.detail: A smaller publication rate fans out to many recipients through a reusable edge response.

scenarios.label: Broadcast burst
scenarios.detail: A hot object fans out quickly enough to challenge client-facing egress even with a high cache hit rate.

failures.label: Healthy capacity
failures.detail: Both boundaries retain their stated link capacity.

failures.label: Half the edge capacity lost
failures.detail: A regional or provider failure removes 50% of client-facing egress.

failures.label: Cache bypass
failures.detail: A policy or keying error sends every delivery attempt across the origin boundary.

failures.label: Origin capacity degraded
failures.detail: Only 35% of origin egress remains while the edge continues accepting demand.
